attleboro-ma.html.q: Is Nova Farms recreational or medical?
attleboro-ma.html.a: We’re a fully recreational dispensary, welcoming all adults 21 and over with a valid ID. That said, wellness is a big part of what we do—our budtenders love discussing cannabinoid ratios, terpene profiles, and tailored consumption methods so you can find relief or relaxation on your own terms.

attleboro-ma.html.q: When is the Nova Farms Attleboro dispensary open?
attleboro-ma.html.a: We open our doors at 8 AM every day of the week and keep the lights on until 11 PM — the same hours seven days a week, Sunday through Saturday.

attleboro-ma.html.q: How much weed can I buy at an Attleboro dispensary near me?
attleboro-ma.html.a: Massachusetts lets any adult buy up to 1 ounce (28 g) of flower per visit—or the equivalent in other forms—which tops out at 5 g of concentrates or roughly 500 mg of THC in edibles. Mix and match however you like; we’ll gladly do the math and guide you if anything’s unclear about how much you can buy of any certain product.

attleboro-ma.html.q: Will someone help me find the right cannabis strains for me?
attleboro-ma.html.a: Absolutely. Our budtenders are genuinely passionate about matching people with the right cannabis, and we’ll take the time to learn what you’re looking to feel—or avoid—before recommending strains, formats, and dose ranges. Whether you’re brand-new or a seasoned consumer, count on us to walk you through aromas, cannabinoid ratios, terpene profiles, and consumption tips so you leave confident and excited about your purchase.

attleboro-ma.html.q: Can I shop for cannabis in MA if I'm from out of state?
attleboro-ma.html.a: Yes—Massachusetts welcomes any adult 21+ to shop recreationally; no residency is required, as long as you show a valid government-issued photo ID. Just remember that federal law still forbids taking cannabis over state lines, so plan to consume or securely store your purchase locally before heading home.

attleboro-ma.html.q: How many MA dispensaries can you visit in a day?
attleboro-ma.html.a: There’s no cap on how many MA dispensaries you can pop into in a single day—you’re free to shop around as much as you like. What is capped is your total take-home: the state lets you buy up to 1 oz of flower (or the equivalent in concentrates or edibles) per day, and each stop logs your purchase in the tracking system so you don’t accidentally exceed the limit.

attleboro-ma.html.q: How does online ordering and pickup work?
attleboro-ma.html.a: Our live menu online shows exactly what’s on the shelves. Add your favorites to the cart, follow the quick checkout prompts, and we’ll text you when your order is ready to go. Bring a valid ID and payment to our Attleboro dispensary, and you’ll leave with your order in minutes.

dracut-ma.html.q: Do I need a medical card to shop?
dracut-ma.html.a: No, as a recreational cannabis dispensary, we serve all shoppers 21 and older. You only need a state-issued, valid photo ID to purchase cannabis products at Nova Farms.
We’re open on Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 10 PM, and on Sunday from 8 AM to 8 PM.

dracut-ma.html.q: Will someone help me find the right products?

dracut-ma.html.q: How much cannabis can I buy at a Massachusetts dispensary?

locations-newbritain-ct.html.q: What do I need to bring to shop at Nova Farms?
locations-newbritain-ct.html.a: If you’re visiting our cannabis dispensary in New Britain, all you need is a valid government-issued photo ID showing you are 21 or older for recreational purchases. Medical patients must also bring their active Connecticut medical marijuana card. Whether you’re local or just visiting, we make access easy and welcoming.

locations-newbritain-ct.html.q: Is Nova Farms a recreational dispensary or a medical dispensary?
locations-newbritain-ct.html.a: Nova Farms is proudly both. As a recreational dispensary in New Britain, we serve adult-use customers who are 21+ with a valid ID. At the same time, we operate as a New Britain medical dispensary for qualified patients. Each menu is tailored to the needs of its audience, with guidance available for every shopper.

locations-newbritain-ct.html.q: Can out-of-state visitors purchase cannabis at your dispensary?
locations-newbritain-ct.html.a: Yes. If you’re from out of state and over the age of 21, you can shop from our adult-use menu. Recreational cannabis in Connecticut is available to all legal adults—no residency required. Medical purchases, however, are limited to registered Connecticut patients.

locations-newbritain-ct.html.q: What kind of help can I expect if I’m new to cannabis?
locations-newbritain-ct.html.a: We’re here to guide, not overwhelm. Whether you’re seeking better sleep, stress support, or just a calming weekend vibe, our team is trained to listen and assist you with finding products tailored to your needs. We’ll walk you through THC and CBD options, suggest proper doses, and explain product types so you leave with confidence.

locations-newbritain-ct.html.q: How much cannabis can I purchase at one time?
locations-newbritain-ct.html.a: Recreational customers in CT can purchase up to 1 ounce of cannabis flower (or the equivalent in other products) per transaction. Medical patients have a higher purchase limit based on a monthly allotment, usually up to 5 ounces. Ask our staff for help if you’re unsure about your current limits.

locations-newbritain-ct.html.q: How does online ordering and pickup work at Nova Farms?
locations-newbritain-ct.html.a: Nova Farms makes online ordering fast and simple. Just visit our New Britain menu, select your products, and place your order for in-store pickup. You’ll receive a confirmation when your items are ready. Bring your ID and payment method when you arrive—our express pickup lanes keep things moving.

locations-newbritain-ct.html.q: When is Nova Farms' New Britain dispensary open?
locations-newbritain-ct.html.a: We’re open every day of the week to serve our community. Regular hours are 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday, and 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM on Sunday. These hours make it easy to swing by before work, after dinner, or during weekend errands.

locations-newbritain-ct.html.q: Can I visit more than one dispensary in CT per day?
locations-newbritain-ct.html.a: Yes. There are no restrictions on the number of dispensaries you can visit in a day. Just remember your purchases still count toward your daily or monthly limits. For medical patients, allotments are tracked in the state’s medical cannabis system.

woodbury-nj.html.q: Is Nova Farms recreational or medical?
woodbury-nj.html.a: We operate exclusively as a recreational (adult-use) Woodbury dispensary. Anyone 21 or older with a valid, government-issued photo ID can shop—no New Jersey medical card is required. If you’re a medical patient, you’re welcome to visit; please note that we follow adult-use purchase limits and tax structure.
Our doors (and drive-thru) are open every day from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

woodbury-nj.html.q: How much cannabis can I buy at a dispensary near me in NJ?
woodbury-nj.html.a: State regulations allow up to 1 ounce (28.35 g) of flower, 4 g of concentrates or vape oil, or 1,000 mg of THC in ingestibles per transaction. These limits are interchangeable—so half an ounce of bud plus 2 grams of wax, for example, also works. If you’re confused about what you can buy, we’ll help you understand the purchase limit breakdown.

woodbury-nj.html.q: How does online ordering and pickup work?
woodbury-nj.html.a: Browse the live menu, add items to your cart, and check out when you’re happy with your selections. We’ll text you when your order is packed. Pull into the marked lane, have your ID and order number ready, and a budtender will verify, ring you out, and hand off the sealed bag—all without you leaving the driver’s seat. Walk-in pickup works the same way, but you’ll simply pick up your order inside the store.

woodbury-nj.html.q: What payment methods are accepted at your recreational dispensary?
woodbury-nj.html.a: We accept cash and debit cards. ATMs are on-site for cash withdrawals, and debit transactions carry a $3.50 processing fee imposed by our payment processor. Because federal banking laws still classify cannabis as Schedule I, traditional credit cards—including Chime and Current—cannot be used.

woodbury-nj.html.q: Will someone help me if I need help finding the right strain?
woodbury-nj.html.a: Definitely. Every team member stays current on new genetics, the products on the menu, and new information about effects or consumption. Share the mood or symptom you hope to address—better sleep, creative focus, post-workout recovery—and we’ll narrow the shelf to a few dialed-in options, explaining potency, flavor, and dosage along the way.

woodbury-nj.html.q: This is my first time shopping for cannabis—what do I need to know?
woodbury-nj.html.a: Bring a valid, unexpired photo ID, and your questions. We’re always happy to offer guidance and education along the way. Cannabis can feel a little overwhelming if you’ve never shopped for it formally, but we’ll be here to guide you and make sure you have a positive experience. We’ll happily walk you through product types, onset times, and responsible use.

woodbury-nj.html.q: Can I shop for cannabis in NJ if I am not a resident?
woodbury-nj.html.a: Yes. New Jersey law focuses on age, not residency. Out-of-state visitors can purchase within the same limits as locals but must keep products in-state—crossing state lines with cannabis remains a federal offense.

woodbury-nj.html.q: How many dispensaries can I visit per day?
woodbury-nj.html.a: There’s no limit on the number of dispensaries you may enter, but your collective purchases for the day cannot exceed the per-transaction limits set by the state. If you enjoy a multi-shop tour, keep each receipt so you can keep tabs on how much you’ve purchased along the way.
